description: VYBE Music v4.1.4 — Liquid Glass Navigation Bar Restored with Smooth Tab Indicator Animation, Google-Themed Update Dialog with Build Code & Google Verified Badge, and Automated Direct OTA Updates.
changelog: Liquid Glass Navigation Bar: Frosted liquid glass backdrop with subtle luminous translucency and specular border outline on the bottom floating navigation bar
Smooth Spring Tab Indicator Animation: Selection indicator pill dynamically stretches and glides between tabs with responsive spring motion
Automatic Glass Migration: Upgraded devices automatically enable the liquid glass navigation bar
Google-Themed Update Dialog: Features the Google 'G' badge, Google Verified security pill, Google Blue accent button, and dark container
Prominent Build Code: Displays Build 9 and Version 4.1.4 in update announcements
Listen Together Beat Sync Precision: Sub-20ms drift synchronization across all paired devices for zero-echo playback
Listen Together Bass Boost: Hardware-accelerated low-frequency bass boost synchronized across connected phones for powerful party sound
Search Navigation & Animation: Fixed tab indicator smoothly highlighting Search and instant search activation from bottom bar
Listen Together Host Control & Stream Sync: Fixed guest automatic track reception from host and defaulted room playback to Host Only Control
Admin Portal Cleanup: Streamlined administrative workflow with Google member profiles
Zero Lag Performance Optimization: Pre-cached viewmodels and smooth 60fps scrolling
